text_blocks.snippet: Hypereosinophilic syndrome (HES) symptoms vary widely, but commonly include fatigue, fever, skin rashes, and respiratory issues like cough and shortness of breath. Other potential symptoms include muscle aches, weakness, memory problems, and confusion. In some cases, HES can lead to serious complications like heart failure, kidney damage, and blood clots.

list.title: Skin:
list.snippet: Rashes, angioedema (swelling under the skin), and pruritus (itching) are common skin manifestations.

list.title: Heart:
list.snippet: HES can cause cardiomyopathy (heart muscle disease), heart failure, and even blood clots in the heart.
